defs.def: a container for holding or carrying things. Baskets are made of thin strips of material that bends and twists easily, for example plastic, wire or wicker. 篮；篓；筐

ex.s: Flowers are everywhere-hanging baskets, window boxes, and planters-just what you imagine in an attractive English market town.
ex.t: 鲜花处处可见——悬挂花篮、窗台花箱和花盆——正是你想象中迷人英国集镇的样子。

ex.s: As I rushed outdoors to empty the wastepaper baskets, the door swung shut behind me.
ex.t: 当我匆忙跑到户外去倒废纸篓时，门在我身后砰地关上了。

ex.s: They’re the little spots of color like throw pillows, mirrors and baskets that most of us use to add visual interest to our rooms.
ex.t: 它们是像抱枕、镜子和篮子那样的小色块，我们大多数人都用它们为房间增添视觉趣味。

ex.s: Nanxiang aside, the best Xiao long bao have a fine skin, allowing them ____41____ (lift) out of the steamer basket without allowing them tearing or spilling any of ____42____ (they) contents.
ex.t: 除了南翔，最好的小笼包皮薄，能让它们（第41空，lift）出蒸笼而不撕裂或洒出（第42空，they）任何馅料。

ex.s: So two by two,I read library books as fast as I could go: rushing them home in the basket of my bicycle.
ex.t: 所以两本两本地，我尽可能快地读图书馆的书：把它们匆忙放在我的自行车篮子里带回家。

ex.s: I put some pine branches into the basket to make this nest safe and comfortable.
ex.t: 尽管有庆祝活动，但在美国，爵士乐观众群体继续萎缩并老龄化，音乐未能与年轻一代建立联系。

defs.def: the amount contained in a basket 一篮，一筐，一篓（的量）
the net and the metal ring it hangs from, high up at each end of a basketball court; a point that is scored by throwing the ball through this net （篮球运动的）篮；投篮得分

ex.s: Summers in the mid-70s were spent at home shooting baskets, hitting a baseball, or throwing a football, preparing for my future as a quarterback on a football team.
ex.t: 70年代中期的夏天，我都在家里投篮、打棒球或扔橄榄球，为我将来当橄榄球队四分卫做准备。

ex.s: A far cry from the bright lights and shiny courts of the National Basketball Association (NBA), it was along this road that Stephen's grandfather built a simple basket by attaching a piece of plastic to a telephone pole.
ex.t: 这与国家篮球协会（NBA）明亮的灯光和闪亮的球场相去甚远。

ex.s: Along this road, Stephen’s grandfather built a simple basket by fixing a piece of plastic to a telephone pole.
ex.t: 沿着这条路，Stephen 的祖父用一块塑料板固定做了一个简易的篮筐。

ex.s: The bumps and rocks that lined the road under the basket caused the ball to bounce in all directions.
ex.t: 沿路排列在篮筐下的颠簸和岩石使球向各个方向弹跳。

ex.s: The ball could go into the heavy, thick basket only when he shot perfectly at its centre.
ex.t: 只有当他完美地瞄准中心投篮时，球才能进入那个又重又厚的篮筐。

ex.s: Only shots perfectly aimed at its centre went into the heavy, thick basket.
ex.t: 只有完美瞄准中心的投篮才能进入那个又重又厚的篮筐。

defs.def: a number of different goods or currencies 一组（不同的物品或货币）
